review_notes: I read the whole file and checked where radialMassDensity is defined and used in the Profile directory. The only repeated pattern is the `unfold radialMassDensity; positivity` nonnegativity argument. It appears in radialScalarForm_nonneg (twice) and in radialDrift_integral_lower. Each copy is 2–3 lines and uses only unfolding and `positivity`. That counts as routine unfolding. A helper lemma such as `radialMassDensity_nonneg` would be a thin wrapper, so it does not meet the rubric. The two `integral_nonneg` branches in radialScalarForm_nonneg are also short. The other proofs (radialDrift_integral_lower, radialScalarForm_coercive, radialMatched_spectral_coercivity) use different reasoning from each other and do not repeat any substantial argument. I did not open the dependent files in full, so I may have missed duplication with other files. This file contains no justified finding under the rubric.
